**v2.1 brings major core engine upgrades and narrative presentation auditing capabilities.**

- Added narrative presentation auditing: checks narrative stance, detects anachronistic dialogue, and verifies knowledge boundaries in character speech.
- Introduced engine namespace isolation to prevent data mixing between Creator and Business engines.
- Engine constructor and API updated; new methods include style recognition and presentation repair.
- Expanded documentation and sample usage for new global state and auditing processes.
- Removed deprecated skill-card.md for cleaner structure.

**English localization and rebranding, documentation update:**

- SKILL.md now fully translated from Chinese to English
- Display name changed from "创作者故事因果引擎" to "Story Causal Engine"
- Description and feature explanations rewritten for an international audience
- All usage instructions, examples, and scenarios are now in English
- No changes to core functionality or engine commands

- Removed the file "skill-card.md".
- No changes to functionality or user-facing features.

- Initial release of 创作者故事因果引擎 (story-engine-for-creator) version 1.0.0.
- Provides deterministic causal reasoning for story creation, including logic auditing and world-building tools.
- Features automated world generation, logical loophole detection, timeline alignment, and multi-language story bridging.
- Supports validation of character actions, consistency across multi-threaded narratives, and scene detail completion.
- Runs fully locally with natural language input; suitable for novels, game scripts, and film screenwriting.
- Available for personal, non-commercial research use.
